title: Well-formed phased migration — NOVALIDATE + batching + per-release session setup
expected_feedback: No violations. Correctly implements phased migration: (1) add nullable column with DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT, (2) PK-range batched backfill, (3) app dual-write, (4) NOT NULL ENABLE NOVALIDATE followed by VALIDATE, which validates under a Row Exclusive lock rather than blocking DML, (5) SET UNUSED for cleanup. Note that DDL_LOCK_TIMEOUT is re-set in phase 5: it is a session setting and phase 5 ships as a separate release, so the value from phase 1 does not carry over. Phase 5 remains irreversible — SET UNUSED cannot be undone — so it still needs a restore/PITR classification.
